topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture topic and sets expectations regarding complement nomenclature.

topics.label: Fundamentals and core structure of the complement system
topics.groupedBecause: They establish the foundational principles, naming conventions, and central activation mechanism of the complement system.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the upstream recognition mechanisms that drive surface convertase assembly and reach the activation threshold.

topics.label: Downstream effector mechanisms
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how activated complement components execute target cell clearance and inflammatory recruitment.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: It explains the regulatory mechanisms that protect host cells from unintended complement-mediated damage.

topics.label: Clinical presentations of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: It outlines the distinct disease phenotypes and pathological consequences associated with deficiencies in individual complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion mechanisms and biotechnological applications
topics.groupedBecause: It explores how pathogens evade complement attack and how microbial evasion factors are utilized in research and therapeutics.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the session and previews the upcoming topic in the course.
